title: Conversation 2026-10-26: the initial structure of a repository should make sense to browse

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner described how a repository's top level should read when opened (in muSrs: an argument area, an essay area, a website, guides), that its coherence emerges from a dreamtime synthesis rather than from waking-hours recording, and that the navigation structure carries its own guidance conversation tied to the repository's purpose, with optional locked levels. This note is the conversation's identity record; the vignette is the owner's words.
